The controller refuses a candidate whose family overlaps a spent (window, family) pair on the split it would run. 'kind' = discovery (many looks, in-sample) | one_look (holdout/confirmation consumed). Reuse of a window for a DIFFERENT family is allowed but counts toward the multiple-testing disclosure.
